title: Modal Logic Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2512.03491v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Neural Networks are indispensable to natural sciences and society. Their impact extends from applications in public health to workforce productivity. Here, we introduce Modal Logic Neural Networks (MLNNs) -- an end-to-end differentiable logical neural network realisation of modal logic which evaluates a learnable truth function across possible-world semantics. This neural architecture handles para-consistency and inconsistency via a learnable world accessibility relation and valuation function. Because the modality is fixed by which frame axioms the relation satisfies rather than by the operator, one differentiable engine covers the epistemic, doxastic, deontic and temporal readings, with applications from verification of reactive and distributed systems to legal discourse and microeconomic utility models. translated_abstract: 神经网络对自然科学与社会而言不可或缺，其影响从公共卫生应用延伸至劳动力生产率。本文提出了模态逻辑神经网络（MLNNs）——模态逻辑的一种端到端可微分的逻辑神经网络实现，它在可能世界语义上评估一个可学习的真值函数。该神经架构通过可学习的世界可达关系和赋值函数来处理次一致性与不一致性。由于模态由关系所满足的框架公理而非算子本身决定，一个可微分引擎即可涵盖认知、信念、义务和时间等多种模态解读，其应用涵盖从反应式和分布式系统的验证到法律话语以及微观经济效用模型。本文提出了可微分克里普克语义的模型，并建立了其可靠性、收敛性和结构性（质）。
tldr: 提出了一种端到端可微分的模态逻辑神经网络，通过可学习的可达关系和赋值函数实现可微分克里普克语义，统一支持认知、信念、义务和时间等模态解读，并能处理不一致性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Modal Logic Neural Networks (MLNNs), an end-to-end differentiable neural realization of modal logic over possible-world (Kripke) semantics with a learnable accessibility relation and valuation function, unifying epistemic, doxastic, deontic, and temporal modalities while handling para-consistency and inconsistency.
